text:
mira: quick heads-up, after yesterday's quant rollout the curation pipeline started returning high dedupe false-negatives for long prompts (>1024 tokens). many near-duplicates slipped into golden candidate picks.

jon: saw weird fingerprint variance too. which quant and model?

mira: qbringup using q8b-int4-sharedkernel on canary, fingerprinting uses the tail-hash sketch which seems sensitive to low-bit noise.

kevin: confirmed on sample set: same doc yields two different fingerprint buckets depending on kernel path. reproduces locally with the new matrix-pack.

label-ops: annotator throughput impacted. Getting duplicates into queues increases churn and disagreement. We paused auto-assign to the longform pool.

mira: mitigation idea: switch dedupe pass to fingerprint-v1 (stable) for dedupe-only re-run on the last 8h window, keep quantized model for generation. cheaper than full rehash.

sophie: alternative: compute locality-sensitive hashes from embeddings instead of raw fingerprint for longform candidates; embeddings appear more stable across quant kernels. Might be heavier but could be scoped to long prompts.

jon: embedding approach sounds promising but requires re-embed cost. quick fallback to fingerprint-v1 is fastest.

deploy-bot: deploy:qbringup-v3 -> succeeded

kevin: quick script to export affected sample ids:
```
./tools/query_candidates.py --pool longform-canary --since 1778840000 --filter lost-fingerprint
```
I can run the re-dedupe with --fingerprint-version v1.

label-ops: do it, please. We'll hold annotation for those IDs until manifest is updated.

mira: plan: 1) pause longform ingest 2) run query to list affected candidates 3) re-run dedupe with v1 for that set 4) produce updated golden pairing manifest and notify label-ops 5) resume.

jon: also add test to canary CI: compare fingerprint distribution across quant kernels for a fixed longform seed set; fail rollout if >0.5% instability.

sophie: noted. I'll open playbook PR to add the embed fallback experiment as follow-up work.

kevin: running re-dedupe now (apply). Will post manifest when done.

label-ops: ack, holding. Please include original instruction ids in the manifest so we don't accidentally relabel with new instructions.

kevin: done. re-dedupe applied. 182 candidates changed buckets, produced manifest: manifests/longform_repair_1778880000.json. Reassigned 49 stuck items to label-ops pool.

mira: running a 100-sample golden rescore now.

label-ops: reminder: annotate using original instructions for any item in manifest. We'll run final consistency check before marking done.

mira: golden rescore results: 94/100 agreement (baseline before regressions was 96/100). improvement vs broken run which was 82/100.

jon: good. re-enable ingest with temporary fallback flag active for the next 24h. I'll create INF-3744 to add the CI gate and INF-3745 for embedding fallback prototype.

sophie: filing INF-3746 for playbook updates.

deploy-bot: ticket created: INF-3744, INF-3745, INF-3746

mira: closing loop: ingest resumed with fingerprint-v1 fallback enabled, manifest posted, label-ops resumed assignments. we'll reconvene after the playbook PR and embedding prototyping. thanks everyone.
